name: Insight Menu Block
author: Bas Buis

sections.description:
Build a menu the familiar WordPress way, then place it in any block theme header.

  1. Create or edit menus under Appearance → Menus.
  2. Insert Insight Menu Block in your header template part.
  3. Choose the menu, alignment, ARIA label, breakpoint, and sub-menu behaviour.
  4. Style base colors and pick a hamburger (Subtle or Default). The mobile overlay shows your menu automatically.
  • Menus from Appearance → Menus, output with wp_nav_menu()
  • Alignment, ARIA label, breakpoint, sub-menu type (hover / click / click-toggle)
  • Full-screen mobile overlay
  • Open mobile sub-menus by clicking the parent item
  • Colors: text, hover, current, hamburger, mobile background / text
  • Hamburger styles: Subtle and Default

Use WordPress core CSS Classes on each menu item (Appearance → Menus; enabled under Screen Options). Those classes are output on the front end.

Pro add-on

Need more? See Insight Menu Block Pro.
* Editable mobile overlay (InnerBlocks)
* Extra overlay-blocks
* 6 hamburger icons
* Height/label mobile icon
* Mobile overlay partial and sideways
* Last dropdown opens left
* Open sub-menus on mobile
* Overlay editing mode (editor toggle)
* Extra spacing, item padding, submenu width
* Font: Inherit, or a font already installed by the theme or the Font Library
* Separate mobile menu, or inherit the desktop menu
* Submenu colors, close color
* Menu-items condition logged-in/logged-out

Menus are stored by WordPress core (nav_menu / nav_menu_item). Deactivating this plugin does not delete them.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from WordPress.org, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Create a menu under Appearance → Menus.
  4. In the Site Editor, open your header template part, insert Insight Menu Block, and choose the menu.
sections.faq:
Does this work with block themes?

Yes. It is built for block themes and restores the Menus screen when the theme does not show it.

Where are menus stored?

In WordPress core navigation menus. They remain if you deactivate the plugin.

1.3.10

  • Font style: Inherit, Normal, Bold, Italic, or Bold italic.

1.3.9

  • Editor menu name reflects font size, text color, and hover color.

1.3.8

  • Mobile overlay block says which menu it uses, instead of asking to select one.

1.3.7

  • Editor shows the selected menu name instead of a cramped item preview. Empty state says “Select a menu”.

1.3.6

  • Readme: Pro add-on features and link.

1.3.5

  • Use the longer insmb / INSMB prefix for functions, classes, constants, and script handles.

1.3.4

  • Side flyouts keep a single close icon inside the panel. The header button stays a hamburger.

1.3.3

  • Full-screen mobile menu no longer shows a second, blue close icon on hover.

1.3.2

  • Doner cells and Ellipsis dots use whole pixels, same as the line icons.

1.3.1

  • Hamburger lines use a whole-pixel thickness so Subtle matches the settings preview on the front end.

1.3.0

  • Public name is Insight Menu Block. Text domain and slug are insight-menu-block. Existing blocks keep rendering.
  • Remove license gates and controls that were limited inside this plugin.
  • Prefix functions, classes, constants, and script handles with wmb / WMB.
  • Block direct access to plugin PHP files.

1.2.3

  • Fix: block no longer stacks under the site title in FSE header rows (shrink-wrap like core Navigation).

1.2.2

  • Pro: side flyout width setting (px, %, rem, etc.).

1.2.1

  • Pro: side flyout mobile menus (left → right / right → left), always full height, with close button.

1.2.0

  • Slug / text domain / block namespace unified to dynamic-block-navigation (matches display name).
  • Legacy block names (dynamic-classic-block-navigation/*) remapped for existing content.

1.1.1

  • Removed duplicate custom CSS class field; use WordPress core CSS Classes on menu items (free + Pro).
  • Core CSS Classes column kept visible on Appearance → Menus; confirmed wired through wp_nav_menu.
  • Pro menu builder field remains: Display (everyone / logged in / logged out).

1.1.0

  • Split optional add-on features out of this plugin.
  • Free: fixed mobile overlay menu (no InnerBlocks canvas); Subtle + Default hamburgers; full overlay.
  • Optional overlay, spacing, and visibility controls lived in this release; they were removed from this plugin in 1.3.0.
  • Updated readme for repository guidelines (5 tags, Tested up to 7.1).

1.0.28

  • Fix: block missing from inserter — editor scripts now declare wp-blocks / wp-block-editor deps (edit.asset.php).

1.0.27

  • Hamburger icons: equal line thickness (no flex-shrink), Unequal matches top-line weight, Default spacing matches settings preview.

1.0.26

  • Added Submenu horizontal spacing (desktop dropdown left/right padding, one value).

1.0.25

  • Color values normalized to 6-digit hex (8-digit #RRGGBBAA ending in 00 made colors invisible).
  • Hex text field for reliable paste; clearer help for Background and Toggle background.

1.0.24

  • Spacing split: Horizontal (desktop main only), Vertical (desktop dropdowns + mobile), Mobile submenu indent.
  • Removed Item gap (padding-based spacing for larger click targets).

1.0.23

  • Unitless size values (gap, spacing, font size, etc.) are treated as px.
  • Clearer help text for item gap vs horizontal/vertical spacing.

1.0.22

  • Renamed Item padding X/Y settings to Horizontal / Vertical spacing menu-items.

1.0.21

  • Default sub-menu type changed from Hover to Click menu item.

1.0.20

  • Toggle: Last dropdown opens left (keeps the rightmost desktop submenu inside the viewport).

1.0.19

  • Editor toggle: show / hide mobile overlay (compact header preview when hidden).

1.0.18

  • Display name: Dynamic Block Navigation (slug unchanged for “classic” discoverability).
  • Updated plugin description; block keywords keep “classic” / “classic menu” for search.

1.0.17

  • Renamed child block to Mobile Menu Items; clarified editor help text.
  • Editor help text sits above the overlay so it stays readable on light backgrounds.

1.0.16

  • Mobile overlay is an editable InnerBlocks column (like Dynamic Popup Flyout).
  • Default Mobile Menu Items block — place image, text, socials, etc. above or below.
  • Removed overlay logo/image settings (use blocks in the overlay instead).

1.0.15

  • Fix partial overlay positioning (full width below header, no longer stuck top-right).

1.0.14

  • Hamburger icon hover color setting.

1.0.13

  • Fix: nav block no longer forces width 100% (prevents header wrap in Frost and similar row layouts).

1.0.12

  • Fix: enable classic menu support before after_setup_theme (stops Frost “theme does not support navigation menus” notice).

1.0.11

  • Strong hamburger lines 40% thicker than Subtle / Unequal / Default.

1.0.10

  • Removed duplicate hamburger color picker (Colors panel only).

1.0.9

  • Unified hamburger line thickness for Subtle, Strong, Default, and Unequal.

1.0.8

  • Renamed plugin slug to dynamic-block-navigation.

1.0.7

  • Per menu/submenu item: CSS class field and Display (everyone / logged in / logged out).

1.0.6

  • Hamburger color control next to the icon picker (same as toggle color).

1.0.5

  • Visual hamburger picker: subtle, strong, unequal, default (+chevron), doner grid, ellipsis.

1.0.4

  • Hamburger styles: 2 lines, 3 lines, uneven widths, plus height setting.

1.0.3

  • Full-overlay close button (top right) with color setting.
  • Optional overlay logo/image with width and vertical padding.
  • Partial overlay now anchors to the header bottom (not just the nav block).

1.0.2

  • Toggle to show sub-menus already open on mobile.

1.0.1

  • Separate mobile text hover color for dark mobile overlays.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: classic menu support for block themes, dynamic block, mobile toggle, colors and layout settings.
